title: Android Data Layer
description: Data layer patterns for Android/KMP: data source vs repository distinction, DTOs and mappers, Room entities and DAOs, Ktor HttpClient setup, safe network call helpers, token storage and refresh, and offline-first strategies. Builds on the android-error-handling Result wrapper for typed errors.
trigger_description: Use whenever writing or reviewing a data source or repository, creating DTOs or Room entities, writing mappers, setting up the Ktor HttpClient, handling network errors, or implementing token refresh. Trigger phrases: "create a repository", "create a data source", "add a DAO", "Ktor client", "write a mapper", "DTO", "Room entity", "network call", "token storage", "offline-first".
author: Philipp Lackner
